8.6.3.30 IUMPRNumerator
[SWS_Dem_00610] Definition of ClientServerInterface IUMPRNumerator ⌈
Name
IUMPRNumerator
Comment
If OBD is configured it provides the capability to define the number of times a fault could have
been found. One port of this interface type is provided per ratio Id by the Dem Service
Component. It has RatioID as a port-defined argument.
IsService
true
Variation
–
0
E_OK
Operation successful
Possible Errors
